tagline: Leading e-commerce platform for buying and selling used cars with integrated supply chain.
hero_kpi_rationale: The Retail Vehicle Unit Sales KPI is the primary driver of the company's growth, with a 43.3% increase in 2025 compared to 2024, reflecting the continued expansion of its used vehicle e-commerce platform.
company_description: Carvana Co., together with its subsidiaries, operates an e-commerce platform for buying and selling used cars. It provides vehicle acquisition, inspection and reconditioning, online search and shopping experience, financing, complementary products, logistics network and distinctive fulfillment experience, and post-sale customer support services. The company also operates auction sites. Carvana Co. was founded in 2012 and is based in Tempe, Arizona.

kpis.name: Retail Vehicle Unit Sales
kpis.explanation: Number of vehicles sold to retail customers
kpis.description: The number of vehicles sold to retail customers is a key indicator of the company's growth and the success of its e-commerce platform.
kpis.signal: Rapid growth in retail vehicle unit sales

kpis.name: Retail Vehicle Sales Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from retail vehicle sales
kpis.description: Revenue generated from retail vehicle sales is a key indicator of the company's growth and its largest source of revenue.
kpis.signal: Rapid growth in retail vehicle sales revenue

kpis.name: Wholesale Sales Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from wholesale vehicle sales and wholesale marketplace
kpis.description: Revenue generated from wholesale vehicle sales, including the wholesale marketplace platform, is a key indicator of revenue diversification.
kpis.signal: Rapid growth in wholesale sales revenue

kpis.name: Other Sales and Revenues
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from gains on sales of finance receivables and complementary products
kpis.description: Revenue generated from monetization of finance receivables and sales of complementary products represents 100% gross margin.
kpis.signal: Rapid growth in other revenue sources

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue (14.5 + 4.1 + 1.7 = 20.3B) reflects balanced growth across all segments.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Annual capex for infrastructure and technology

risks.title: Macroeconomic Downturn and Consumer Demand
risks.summary: An economic recession or decline in consumer demand may lead to reduced vehicle sales and impact financial performance.
risks.score_rationale: The company is sensitive to economic trends, market fluctuations, and credit conditions, which can significantly impact demand for used vehicles.

risks.title: Intense Competition
risks.summary: Increased competition may result in market share loss, margin compression, and higher customer acquisition costs.
risks.score_rationale: The used vehicle market is highly fragmented but intensely competitive. Automakers, traditional dealerships, and e-commerce players compete for market share.

risks.title: Credit Risk
risks.summary: Payment defaults or deterioration in credit quality may lead to financial losses and affect liquidity.
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risk related to the origination and holding of finance receivables from buyer customers.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
risks.summary: Cybersecurity breaches may result in financial losses, remediation costs, loss of customer trust, and regulatory issues.
risks.score_rationale: As an e-commerce platform, Carvana is vulnerable to cybersecurity attacks that could compromise sensitive customer and operational data.

risks.title: Technology Dependence
risks.summary: Technological failures, service interruptions, or platform issues may disrupt sales and impact customer experience.
risks.score_rationale: Carvana's business model relies heavily on its technology infrastructure, online systems, and automated logistics capabilities.

risks.title: Regulatory Changes
risks.summary: Regulatory changes in automotive standards, financing, consumer protection, or environmental practices may affect operations.
risks.score_rationale: Carvana operates in a regulated industry with federal, state, and local requirements that may change and increase compliance costs.

risks.title: Supply Chain Disruption
risks.summary: Supply chain disruptions, logistics failures, or increased transportation costs may impact profitability and delivery timelines.
risks.score_rationale: Carvana's ability to acquire and recondition vehicles depends on its integrated logistics network and transportation partners.
